_comment: Template for the ats-search company registry. Copy to job_scraper/companies.json and put your own target companies in it - the real file is gitignored. Add the exact careers_url you found; the board UI saves it, detects vendor/token, and exposes monitoring_status plus will_be_searched. The persisted status remains the ATS identity status used by the CLI. Nothing is promoted to status:verified without identity evidence. See .agents/skills/ats-search/SKILL.md. `defaults.vendor_access` records vendor policy; a disabled vendor is never reported as searchable.

conditional_exclude.why: A working-student contract usually requires local enrolment; keep it only where you are actually enrolled.

smartrecruiters.why: api.smartrecruiters.com/robots.txt is `User-agent: LinkedInBot / Allow: /v1/companies/` then `User-agent: * / Disallow: /`: every agent but LinkedIn's is disallowed from the whole host. This block is belt-and-braces - the same policy is compiled into the CLI (registry.ts POLICY_BLOCKED), so deleting this block does NOT re-enable the vendor. Set enabled true only if you have decided to run it as personal use, at low volume, at your own responsibility.

companies.name: [YOUR_TARGET_COMPANY]
companies.note: [YOUR_NOTE - what actually matters when you apply here: the real seniority ask, a contact, the interview process]

companies.name: [YOUR_BIG_EMPLOYER_WITHOUT_A_PUBLIC_BOARD]
companies.note: Workday or a custom board - v1 has no adapter, so this row states target coverage, not adapter coverage. Keep it: the dashboard should show who you are watching.
